en.headline: Police arrest 56-year-old man over indecent assault at Tsing Yi MTR station
en.dek: Officers identified the suspect through CCTV after a woman reported being assaulted at the station on Sunday and detained him at a bus terminus on Tuesday.
body: Police arrested a 56-year-old local man on Tuesday over an alleged indecent assault at Tsing Yi MTR station on Sunday.

Officers received a report that day that a woman had been indecently assaulted and that the man involved had fled. The Tsing Yi divisional task force reviewed a large amount of closed-circuit television footage and identified the suspect.

Police arrested the man at the Tsing Yi Town bus terminus on Tuesday. He is being detained for investigation. Police said indecent assault is a serious offence carrying a maximum penalty of 10 years’ imprisonment.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕56歲男子 涉青衣港鐵站非禮
zh.dek: 事主周日報案指在青衣站被非禮，警方經閉路電視鎖定嫌疑，周二在巴士總站拘捕他。
body: 警方周二拘捕一名56歲本地男子，涉嫌在周日於青衣港鐵站非禮一名女子。
警方當日接報有女子被非禮，涉事男子逃離。青衣分區特遣隊檢視大量閉路電視片段後成功辨認嫌疑。
周二在青衣城巴士總站拘捕該名男子，正扣留調查。警方指非禮屬嚴重罪行，最高可判監禁十年。
